title: Reviewer result tool contract
description: CME v3.0 §2.T5 — input_schema for the report_reviewer tool forced via tool_choice. Combined Reviewer contract: evaluates spec compliance (spec_score) and implementation quality (quality_score), surfaces issues[], and escalates when blocked.

status.description: PASS: no issues; WARN: advisory issues only; FAIL: SPEC or QUALITY issues; SPEC_FAULT: spec itself is defective.

spec_score.description: 0.0–1.0 spec-compliance score, quantized to 1 decimal (PASS threshold 0.85). Matches the reviewer-prompt scale and the kernel tier thresholds.

quality_score.description: 0.0–1.0 implementation quality score, quantized to 1 decimal (PASS threshold 0.75). Matches the reviewer-prompt scale and the kernel tier thresholds.

issues.description: Empty when status==PASS; otherwise the list of findings.

spec_fault.description: Present when status==SPEC_FAULT — characterises the spec defect.

escalate.description: Present when the reviewer cannot proceed without orchestrator input.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence — error output, file path, conflicting spec lines.

question.description: Specific question for the orchestrator to resolve.

severity.description: SPEC: deviates from the task spec; QUALITY: code quality concern; ADVISORY: informational.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the affected file, or 'N/A'.
